summary:
I'm a Computer Science & Engineering student at United International University, navigating the intersection of software development and artificial intelligence. I build systems that solve real problems — from supply chain platforms that beat 55 teams to deep learning models published in IEEE — driven by one clear goal: becoming an AI/ML Engineer.

Development is my foundation. AI/ML is my direction. Everything I build is a step toward that intersection where intelligent systems meet the real world.
